data.name: Jamsheed
data.gender_notes: Jamsheed is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jamsheed is a name derived from the Arabic root 'as-h-d' meaning 'to rule' or 'to govern'. In Islamic history, Jamsheed is often referenced as a just and fair king who ruled with wisdom and compassion. He is also mentioned in the Quran as a prophet and a descendant of Prophet Ibrahim (Abraham). The name Jamsheed carries the meaning “King, Ruler” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jamsheed usually hope their child will grow to embody king, ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes strong leadership and wise governance.
data.etymology: Jamsheed belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “King, Ruler.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jamsheed total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: جمشيد
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم علم مذكر من أصل فارسي، يعني الشخص الذي يشرب من الخمر، ويعرف أيضًا بالملك أو الحاكم، ويرجع أصوله إلى الأساطير الفارسية حيث كان جمشيد ملكًا عادلًا وشجاعًا في الشاهنامة الفارسية، ويستخدم في الثقافة الإسلامية كاسم للذكور

in_urdu.name: جمشید
in_urdu.meaning: وہ شخص جو شراب پیتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: یہ ایک علم مذکر ہے جو فارسی سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جو شراب پیتا ہے یا بادشاہ، جمشید فارسی اساطیر کا ایک مشہور بادشاہ تھا جس کا ذکر فردوسی کی شاہنامہ میں آیا ہے، اسلامی ثقافت میں یہ نام مذکر کے طور پر استعمال ہوتا ہے

in_hindi.name: जमशेद
in_hindi.long_meaning: यह एक पुल्लिंग नाम है जो फारसी से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है जो व्यक्ति शराब पीता है या राजा, जामशेद फारसी पौराणिक कथाओं का एक प्रसिद्ध राजा था जिसका उल्लेख फ़िरदौसी के शाहनामा में है, इस्लामी संस्कृति में यह नाम पुरुषों के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है

in_pashto.name: جمشید
in_pashto.long_meaning: دا د مذکر یو ساینس دی چې د فارسي څخه اخیستل شوی دی، معنی یې هغه څوک چې شراب څښي یا پاچا، جمشید د فارسي افسانو يو مشهور پاچا و چې د فردوسي د شاهنامې په کې يې ذکر شوی، په اسلامي کلتور کې دا نوم د ذکورو لپاره کارول کيږي

in_english.name: Jamsheed
in_english.long_meaning: Derived from Persian roots, Jamsheed means a person who drinks wine or a king, historically significant in Persian mythology as a just and brave ruler, mentioned in Firdusi's Shahnameh, used in Islamic tradition as a male given name symbolizing royalty and courage

data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Jamsheed signifies the idea of divine guidance and righteous rule. historical_references.reference: Jamsheed is believed to be the Islamic name for the legendary Persian king, Jamshid or Yima. He is considered the first just and wise king in Persian mythology, who ruled during the mythical age of gold (Zoroastrianism). Jamsheed was reputed to have brought civilization to mankind, including agriculture, laws, and arts.

Jamshid or Yima is also mentioned in the Islamic scripture, the Quran, as one of the great kings of ancient Persia. The Quran mentions him as a just and pious king who ruled over his people with wisdom and provided them with blessings. The exact passage in the Quran is Surah Al-Anbiya, verse 86.
